title: Normalized integral reduction cone
statement: Let ℓ be a prime. There exists a natural cone ρ from the continuous-function condensed ring of ℓ-adic integers to the constant quotient tower Z_ℓ/(ℓ)^r, including exponent zero, such that on constant sections every component is the usual quotient homomorphism. The objects and constant-section normalization are those of [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x].

lean.statement:
theorem pur_normalized_reduction_cone (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] :
    ∃ ρ : (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[ℓ])) ⟶
        sfbCoefficientQuotientTower ℤ_[ℓ]
          (Ideal.span ({(ℓ : ℤ_[ℓ])} : Set ℤ_[ℓ])) ⋙ sfbPointConstantRing,
      ∀ r, sfbConstantToContinuous ℤ_[ℓ] ≫ (ρ.app (op r)).hom =
        (constantSheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}).map
          (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
            (ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom.comp
              ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({(ℓ : ℤ_[ℓ])} : Set ℤ_[ℓ]) ^ r)).comp
                ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom)).toAddMonoidHom)
